title.narrative: Integrated Health, Sexual Reproductive Health, and Outbreak Response for Conflict-Affected Populations in Madagali LGA of Adamawa State.

description.narrative: ltpgtConflict, repeated displacement, and the 2025 lean season have sharply increased preventable illness, acute malnutrition, and GBV risks in Madagali LGA. This project will deliver an integrated, life-saving health and GBV package through support to 3 public primary health facilities and 3 Mobile Medical Outreach teams, reaching 16,700 people with essential primary healthcare (OPD, IMCI, RMNCH, MHPSS, CMR), and disease surveillance/outbreak response (cholera, measles, malaria). Activities will embed AAP, PSEA, gender equality, and disability inclusion from design to delivery, as required by NHF. While LESGO coordinates the project management and oversees the health facility intervention, SORASUN, with community-based experience, will spearhead the Mobile Health Outreach services.ltbrgtMobile Medical Outreach teams will extend access to hard-to-reach wards/communities, integrate SRH (ANC, skilled delivery linkages, PNC, FP counselling), community-based RCCE on outbreaks and SRH/GBV, rapid referrals, and RRT actions when alerts emerge. Health facilities will be equipped with essential medicines/commodities and staffed with trained providers on survivor-centered care, clinical management of rape (CMR), and GBV risk-mitigating service flow.ltbrgtThe model directly aligns with the NHF 2025 SA2 lean-season focus on integrated primary health care service delivery, with an emphasis on lifesaving services in the BAY states, emphasizing the stabilization of mortality/morbidity, cholera preparedness, and protection of women, girls, adolescents, and persons with disabilities. It will coordinate with sector partners to avoid duplication and strengthen government systems through training, joint supervision, and 5W reporting. All these will be done by the collaboration between LESGO and SRF in the said location, with total commitment to the community and a beneficiary-centered approach, ensuring community ownership and inclusive implementation lt/pgt
